race.comment: ENEA (6) gets the nod. He was very game on debut here over this trip, sitting just off the pace and missing a head when just shaded late. He should improve off that and maps for every chance from the soft gate. GOLD CHALICE (7) ran a strong race on debut at Geelong before struggling in treacherous conditions at Bendigo. Willing to forgive that and trust the market which sent him out a $2.15 favourite. Can bounce right back. FIERY FUN (11) debuted in a good race behind Saintly Dancer & Ghana's Akan. We should get a good guide to that form in the previous race and it should hold up. TECKNOKING (3) is a Written Tycoon gelding who can run well for Cliff Brown on debut, while PINAZAKI (10) could be an improver in his second campaign.
